positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: • Used Ruby on Rails to improve ASPC website (pomonastudents.org) providing course and professor reviews, dining and housing information, online voting system to 5000+ students at the Claremont Colleges
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Pandas · Data Preparation · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed benchmarking study concluding Oracle AutoMLx in a < 1-minute runtime constraint had the top accuracy against NeuralProphet, Amazon DeepAR and Facebook Prophet on 24 time series datasets.

• Discovered optimal accuracy in an > 1-minute runtime by tuning NeuralProphet's hyperparameters with Optuna, leading to a 20% avg. reduction in sMAPE across 24 datasets.

• Developed automated script pipelines in YAML for model training, hyperparameter tuning, and result aggregation on configured storage in Oracle Cloud
positions.insights: Skills: Forecasting · Python (Programming Language) · Oracle Cloud · YAML · Pandas · Data Visualization · Data Cleaning · Machine Learning

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Increased synthetic dataset size by 126x via programmed commands to randomize four simulation parameters in UE5 with open-source software, generated dataset vital to lab’s research in image classification for autonomous navigation

• Accepted abstract and presented findings to SoCal Robotics Symposium (SCR) at UCLA
positions.insights: Skills: Unreal Engine 5 · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning Experiment Tracking

positions.title: Athlete
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:

• 3x Age Group National Champion, Former Age Group National Record Holder
